title: Plaguemist Ravine
wikitext:
[[File:Plaguemist Ravine.jpg|thumb|Plaguemist Ravine.]]

'''Plaguemist Ravine''' is a pathway in the [[Hinterlands]]{{coords|25|44|Hinterlands}} which leads north to [[Caer Darrow]] in the [[Western Plaguelands]]. It is located northwest of [[Quel'Danil Lodge]], and the entrance to it can be found within the woods west of Quel'Danil Lodge at {{coords|20|48|Hinterlands}} on the other side of the mountain. This can also be found to the north of [[Rhapsody Shindigger]] at [[Shindigger's Camp]]. There are no mobs or NPCs in this [[subzone]].

The name "Plaguemist Ravine" was given recently, as the plaguing mist from the pathway is a stark contrast to the natural freshness of the rest of the Hinterlands.
